#| label: get_urls
#| include: false

# Some git-functions:
get_url <- function() {
  remotes <- gert::git_remote_list()
  url     <- remotes$url[remotes$name == "origin"]
  gsub("\\.git$", "", url)
}
tag_url     <- function(tag) paste0(get_url(), "/tree/", tag)
release_url <- function(release) paste0(get_url(), "/releases/tag/", release)
# Make compare-url 2 previous tag or SHA:
compare2prev <- function(prev, current = gert::git_info()$commit) {
  paste0(url, "/compare/", prev, "...", current)
}
# compare2prev("pre-dbl-v1.0")
tag_sha <- function(tag, warn = TRUE) {
  stopifnot(is.character(tag) && length(tag) == 1L)
  tags <- gert::git_tag_list() |> as.data.table()
  if(tags[, !tag %in% name]) {
    if(warn) warning("'tag' is not valid. Valid tags are: ", 
                     paste(tags[, name], collapse = ", "))
    return("main") # return HEAD
  }
  # tags[name == tag][1L, commit] # Note: the 3rd row SHA may not be a valid commit SHA!
  gert::git_commit_id(tag)   # Use this instead
}


tag_name <- function(sha) { # sha <- info$commit
  stopifnot(is.character(sha) && length(sha) == 1L)
  tags <- gert::git_tag_list() |> as.data.table()
  if(!tags[, sha %in% commit]) "none" else tags[sha == commit][1L, name]
}


# Get list of Git info:
info <- gert::git_info()

# Get github-url to repo:
url          <- get_url()
pre_dbl_url  <- release_url("pre-dbl-v1.0")
post_dbl_url <- release_url("post-dbl-v1.0")
commit_url   <- tag_url(info$commit)
main_url     <- tag_url("main")
diff_url     <- compare2prev(prev = "pre-dbl-v1.0", current = "post-dbl-v1.0")
pre_dbl_SHA  <- tag_sha("pre-dbl-v1.0")
post_dbl_SHA <- tag_sha("post-dbl-v1.0")
tag_here     <- tag_name(info$commit)

# Versions (write out in text for each release):
quarto_v <- as.character(quarto::quarto_version())
pandoc_v <- as.character(rmarkdown::pandoc_version())

# Expected versions: (revise stated versions below of not true)
stopifnot(R.version.string == "R version 4.6.0 (2026-04-24 ucrt)",
          quarto_v == "1.9.38",
          pandoc_v == "3.8.3")

# Changelog

**Changes to the analysis code and results for the DEXA-PSYCH trial are documented here.**

- Pre-specified and pre-programmed results of the statistical analyses for the DEXA-PSYCH trial are available in in browsable web-books containing the so-called Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLF-books).
- Additional post-hoc results will be made available when produced.
- Archived code or results are never edited, tags are not moved, archived books are not replaced, and corrections appear as new releases.
- Tags identify snapshots of the code base. 
- Releases are made primarily to publish new results or to correct existing results. Note that all releases are tags but not all tags are releases.


**Tags are versioned by the kind of change:**

| Type        | Meaning                                             | Version  |
|---          |---                                                  |---       |
| Maintenance | Code or environment changes. Results are unchanged. | `v1.0.x` |
| Addition    | New results. Existing results are unchanged.        | `v1.x.0` |
| Correction  | Visible changes to presented results.               | `vx.0.0` |


## [v1.0.3-draft](`r main_url`) --- `r Sys.Date()` (no release)

- **Type:** Maintenance
- **Summary:**: Update of computing environment (only)
- **Corrections:** None
- **Additions:** None
- **Major changes:** None
- **Minor changes:** 
  1. Edits to `README.md`
- **Effect on results:**
  - Reproducibility checks showed no differences in any published results to `v1.0.2`.
- **Commit:** [HEAD](`r main_url`)
- **Changes to code:** [compare-view](`r compare2prev("v1.0.2", current = "main")`)
- **Environment:** R version 4.6.0 (2025-10-31 ucrt), Quarto 1.9.38, Pandoc 3.8.3.


## [v1.0.2](`r tag_url("v1.0.2")`) --- 2026-10-31 (no release)

- **Type:** Maintenance
  - Update of computing environment (only)
- **Corrections:** None
- **Additions:** None
- **Major changes:** 
  1. R updated from 4.5.2 to 4.6.0 (newest available at workplace)
  2. All R packages updated to newest available version and `renv.lock` file updated.
- **Minor changes:** None
- **Effect on results:** 
  - Reproducibility checks showed no differences in any published results to `v1.0.1`.
  - The attributes of some model objects (MMRM) stored alongside the datasets changed due to package updates. This had no influence on the analysis results to a tolerance of $10^{-6}$ and no number in the published results changed due to this update of the computing environment.
- **Commit:** [`r tag_sha("v1.0.2", warn = FALSE)`](`r tag_sha("v1.0.2", warn = FALSE) |> tag_url()`)
- **Changes to code:** [compare-view](`r compare2prev("v1.0.1", current = "v1.0.2")`)
- **Environment:** R version 4.6.0 (2025-10-31 ucrt), Quarto 1.9.38, Pandoc 3.8.3.


## [v1.0.1](`r tag_url("v1.0.1")`) --- 2026-10-30 (no release)

- **Type:** Maintenance 
- **Corrections:** None
- **Additions:** None
- **Major changes:** 
  1. Save `rds` files of results of manual analyses to enable reproducibility checks at full precision (checks at the displayed precision levels is already covered by `html` tables.)

- **Minor changes:** 
  1. Add Change-log to repo.
  1. `renv` lock file update with packages 3 packages (`httr`, `rvest`, `selectr`)

  - Reproducibility checks showed no differences to `post-dbl-v1.0`.
- **Commit:** [`r tag_sha("v1.0.1")`](`r tag_sha("v1.0.1") |> tag_url()`)
- **Changes to code:** [compare-view](`r compare2prev("post-dbl-v1.0", current = "v1.0.1")`)
- **Environment:** R version 4.5.2 (2025-10-31 ucrt), Quarto 1.9.38, Pandoc 3.8.3.
